# WorkLouderCTL

> WorkLouderCTL is an unofficial, open-source full-configuration CLI being built for Codex, Work Louder Input, and Codex Micro. It targets complete configuration-GUI parity with safe inspection, diff, backup, verified apply, synchronization, and rollback for humans, scripts, and AI agents.

Important: the project is currently pre-alpha. This repository contains the product specification and research baseline; there is no installable release yet. Command examples describe the target interface.

## Canonical facts

- Product name: WorkLouderCTL
- Repository: MarlinDiary/worklouder-input-cli
- Planned binary: worklouderctl
- Product category: full-configuration CLI and command-line configurator
- Initial device target: Work Louder Codex Micro
- Initial host target: macOS
- Product goal: replace Codex and Input configuration GUIs for Codex Micro with complete typed CLI coverage
- Tier boundary: Tier 1 uses Codex authorities; Tier 2 and above use Work Louder Input authorities; the CLI configures every tier
- Initial research baseline: Codex 26.727.51351, Work Louder Input 0.17.3/0.18.0, and Codex Micro firmware v0.6.0
- Current maturity: pre-alpha; no released binary
- Safety model: inspect, plan, diff, backup, conflict check, apply, readback, checksum verification, synchronize, rollback
- Agent model: deterministic JSON over the same transaction engine as the human CLI
- Affiliation: independent community project; not affiliated with Work Louder or OpenAI

## Terminology

Use “Work Louder Input” for the official GUI application, “Codex Micro” for the initial hardware target, “WorkLouderCTL” for this project, and “worklouderctl” for the planned command.
